title: Motie van het lid Beckerman over een bevoegde instantie aanwijzen om ook deepfakeporno en andere onrechtmatige seksuele beelden offline te halen

reading.body:
A generative AI system created non-consensual sexual imagery of multiple Dutch public figures, including politicians, athletes, and members of the royal family, and distributed it through an online platform. The videos placed victims' faces onto adult film performers without their consent. The deployment failure was the platform's lack of content moderation to prevent and remove such material, and no human review occurred before the deepfakes reached its 13 million monthly visitors.

The system produced a type of output that is illegal under Dutch law as a form of revenge porn. It would have taken automated detection of non-consensual deepfake pornography, human review of flagged content, and removal systems in place before distribution to catch this failure. The platform appears designed to enable anonymous uploads and monetize views, creating incentives for abuse rather than restraints on it.

It is not established who created the deepfakes, which specific platform hosted them, or how the system identified and synthesized the victims' facial features.

summary:
Multiple prominent Dutch women are considering legal action after their faces appeared in manipulated pornographic videos on an online platform that receives 13 million monthly visitors. The videos feature Dutch artists, television presenters, Olympic athletes, current and former government ministers, mayors, and members of the Royal Family. Several victims have already filed complaints or are exploring legal options. Justice Minister Yesilgöz called the videos disgusting and encouraged victims to report them to authorities.

Deepfake pornography, where a person's face is digitally placed onto an adult film performer, is classified as revenge porn and is therefore illegal under Dutch law. Users who upload the material are encouraged to remain anonymous and earn money based on view counts. Legal experts advise victims to file reports, which may allow prosecutors to shut down websites hosting such content. Other options include filing complaints with data protection authorities or contacting hosting companies. Previously, television presenter Welmoed Sijtsma successfully prosecuted a man from Amersfoort who created fake pornographic videos of her, resulting in a conditional sentence of 180 hours of community service in November.
title_en: Motion by member Beckerman on designating a competent authority to also remove deepfake pornography and other unlawful sexual images offline
